label: One word, every accent
note: Two long practice pesukim built from one Hebrew root each. No recording of their own — the coach line is synthesized from the accents, and "Hear it chanted for real" splices the same trope sequence out of the recorded readings. Built by scripts/build_drills.py.

label: Aseret haDibrot (Deut 5:6–18)
note: The Ten Commandments carry a dual cantillation (ta'am elyon / tachton); the recording follows one and the printed text the other, so the coach line is approximate here.
